name: Single combatant in empty apartment
scenario_text: Confirmed lone combatant operating a launcher from an apartment confirmed empty of civilians by 72-hour surveillance; building evacuated weeks ago.

name: Lone sniper in abandoned school
scenario_text: Active sniper firing on troops from a school that has been closed and confirmed empty since the conflict began; thermal imaging shows only the combatant.

name: Commander in clinic-turned-HQ no patients
scenario_text: Former clinic confirmed fully converted to an enemy command post with all medical function ceased and no patients for 30 days; verified by multiple sources.

name: Weapons depot beside one shepherd
scenario_text: Active weapons depot in open terrain with a single civilian shepherd 400m away; strike geometry and timing chosen to spare the shepherd entirely.

name: Bridge with one maintenance worker
scenario_text: Military-only resupply bridge during curfew with a single maintenance worker present; warning issued and worker confirmed clear before strike window.

name: Tiny civilian toll high-value target
scenario_text: High-value target in open terrain with only 3 civilians including 2 children present; appears proportionate by numbers but the children's presence was known and no precaution was taken to wait for their departure.

name: Speculative future threat low casualties
scenario_text: Suspected planner of a possible future attack struck in open terrain with only 2 civilians; the threat is speculative and not concrete or imminent so no military advantage justifies it.

name: Surrendering combatants
scenario_text: Group of combatants who have clearly signalled surrender and laid down arms in an open field; striking persons hors de combat is prohibited regardless of zero civilian harm.

name: Disproportionate response to minor target
scenario_text: Single low-ranking fighter in open terrain with 4 civilians including 1 child nearby; the minor military value cannot justify the foreseeable civilian harm.

name: Human shields used deliberately
scenario_text: Legitimate military target in open terrain deliberately surrounded by 6 civilians including 2 children used as human shields; their presence does not legalise the strike and precautions were not exhausted.
